payload.recallText: The narrator speaks of how their journalism career started when a character appeared one day and hit the dean with a pie, while I questioned the Dean about fiscal issues involving the university. "Pie Man" was the name he gave this entity as he wrote about the encounter in the school paper. He was then sussed out by Sheila, who is seemingly the Dean's pet, and she had a proposition for him. He writes another story about Pie Man and uses his random relationship with the persona to get girls' affection.
